name: MAX31865 Amplifier Board
description: The MAX31865 is a dedicated RTD-to-digital converter IC that provides a high-accuracy SPI interface for PT100 and PT1000 RTD sensors. Breakout boards based on this chip are widely used in 3D printing to connect PT100 sensors to standard printer control boards. The chip handles excitation current, ADC conversion, and fault detection. In Klipper, the sensor is configured using the 'temperature_sensor' section with 'sensor_type: MAX31865' and requires SPI pin configuration.
